import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json

def run(_context):
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    targets = [
        ('mx_plate_gasket v1', '/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/pcb/mx_plate/gasket_v1/mx_plate_gasket.dxf', 'LEFT_PLATE_SURFACE'),
        ('mx_plate_right_tb_gasket v1', '/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/pcb/mx_plate_right_tb/gasket_v1/mx_plate_right_tb_gasket.dxf', 'RIGHT_TB_PLATE_SURFACE'),
    ]
    out = []
    for target_name, path, sketch_name in targets:
        doc = None
        for i in range(app.documents.count):
            d = app.documents.item(i)
            if d.name == target_name:
                doc = d
                break
        if doc is None:
            out.append({'document': target_name, 'error': 'document not open'})
            continue
        activated = bool(doc.activate())
        des = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
        if des is None:
            out.append({'document': target_name, 'error': 'not a Fusion design'})
            continue
        root = des.rootComponent
        before = root.sketches.count
        im = app.importManager
        opts = im.createDXF2DImportOptions(path, root.xYConstructionPlane)
        ok = bool(im.importToTarget(opts, root))
        added = []
        for j in range(before, root.sketches.count):
            sk = root.sketches.item(j)
            sk.name = sketch_name if j == before else sketch_name + '_' + str(j - before + 1)
            sk.isVisible = True
            added.append({'name': sk.name, 'lines': sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines.count, 'arcs': sk.sketchCurves.sketchArcs.count, 'circles': sk.sketchCurves.sketchCircles.count, 'profiles': sk.profiles.count})
        out.append({'document': doc.name, 'activated': activated, 'imported': ok, 'sketches_before': before, 'sketches_after': root.sketches.count, 'added': added})
    print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False))
